description: First-person voiceover with a recurring face-stand-in (anime portrait, motion graphic, or stylized R-mark) intercut with real captures of GitHub, terminal, and product UI. Captures the talking-head energy of Riley Brown / Sabrina Ramonov / vibecoding creators without requiring on-camera presence.
recommended_use: Rally pitch and thesis content where personality matters but on-camera presence is off-table. The face-stand-in becomes a brand mark over time. Best for: project announcements, decisions narrated in first person, reactions to engagement signal.
reference_notes: First-person script. The stand-in 'speaks' on behalf of the builder.
Static caption boxes hold 2-4s, mirroring Riley Brown's red-on-black overlay pattern.
Stand-in is a single recurring visual asset (anime portrait, R-mark with mouth, or motion graphic).
Cuts between stand-in and real capture should average 1 cut every 2-3 seconds.
Reference library row 13-16 (Sabrina Ramonov, Mariah Brunner — talking head + branded education).
If the stand-in feels uncanny in eval, this card's failure is the cue to consider real-Chris-on-camera.
End with explicit comment-CTA, e.g. 'comment merge if you'd build this'.

camera: subtle push-in on stand-in during emphasis beats
fast match-cuts between stand-in and screen
texture: consistent stand-in identity across all panels
static caption boxes with bold text
real screen captures as cutaway b-roll
no cinematic bokeh or color grading
composition_rules: Stand-in shot type matches face-camera framing (shoulder-up, eyes engaged).
Cutaways to real screen happen on key claims, not cosmetically.
Caption boxes occupy bottom 25% or upper 25%, never cover the stand-in's face area.
Stand-in must remain visually consistent across all panels — same color palette, same composition style.
Final panel returns to stand-in centered with the comment-CTA caption.

caption_treatment.style: static red-on-black box with bold white text, 2-4s holds

default_routes.stand_in_hook: NB2 generated stand-in (anime portrait or R-mark) with subtle motion
default_routes.first_person_claim: NB2 stand-in close-up + caption box overlay
default_routes.real_capture_proof: real screen recording (terminal, github, browser) with annotation
default_routes.stand_in_reaction: NB2 stand-in with motion-intent (eye dart, head turn, expression shift)
default_routes.result_or_demo: real screen recording at moment of result
default_routes.comment_cta: static text card with rally yellow background OR stand-in centered with caption

fallback_routes.stand_in_hook: static stand-in image with assembly motion overlay
fallback_routes.stand_in_reaction: static stand-in with assembly zoom/pulse effect
fallback_routes.stand_in_drift_between_panels: regenerate panel with explicit reference image of locked stand-in
